card.name: Last digit of a dose number
card.fires_on: A digit inside a multi-digit dose number, often the final 0 or 5, right before a unit like mg or mcg. It appears in dose statements for drugs.

modes.label: Trailing zero in whole doses
modes.description: The digit 0 ending a round dose such as 20, 30, 100 or 320, followed by mg or mcg.
modes.example: Limit the dose of simvastatin in patients on any dose of Ranolazine Extended-Release Tablets to 2<<0>> mg once daily
